header: Secretary of the Treasury and Secretary

result.reason: Both definitions must be understood together to establish the regulatory distinction between which persons may act as Secretary versus Secretary of the Treasury in applicable provisions.
The provision enumerates mutually exclusive and exhaustive interpretations of the term based on whether it refers to the Secretary of Treasury or another official.
All three sub-provisions must be simultaneously satisfied for an entity to qualify as a domestic building and loan association.
Defines inputs (total assets), condition (60% threshold at year-end), and output (qualification for asset composition test), requiring computation to apply.
result.inputs: total assets of association at close of taxable year; asset composition by type
result.condition: assets must be of enumerated types and constitute at least 60% of total
result.output: whether entity meets qualifying asset percentage test
